You get before and after scores and a plain list of every change.

faq: No. We fix the technical side, so that pages load quickly and search engines read them properly. Where you rank also depends on your content, competition and links.
Will you change how my site looks?
No. The changes happen under the surface. We check each page before and after, and tell you about any visible difference.
Which frameworks do you work with?
Next.js, React, Astro, Vue and Nuxt are the usual ones. If your site is built in another framework, send the link and we say whether we can help.
What do I need to provide?
Repository access or a staging copy, and the address of the live site for measurement. Search Console access helps us pick the right pages.
